business: Collabo (brand side): a self-serve marketplace where small businesses hire creators with escrow
target: US small-business owners and marketers who want influencer marketing but have no agency and under $3,000 a month to spend on it

segments.name: Local business owner (cafe, restaurant, gym, salon)
Founder of a small online (DTC) brand
Marketing manager at a 10-50 person company

behaviours.name: DIY on Instagram
behaviours.how: Already DMs creators directly and pays them by Venmo or PayPal, or with free product.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Paid a creator once who posted late, posted something off-brand, or vanished.

behaviours.name: Numbers first
behaviours.how: Only spends on marketing that can be tracked to sales, and runs Meta ads today.

behaviours.name: Never tried influencers
behaviours.how: Curious, has seen competitors do it, doesn't know where to start or what to pay.

behaviours.name: Uses another platform
behaviours.how: Has booked creators on Collabstr or a similar marketplace before.

behaviours.name: Agency-curious
behaviours.how: Got an agency quote and found the minimum too high.

behaviours.name: Bargain hunter
behaviours.how: Prefers gifting free product over paying creators cash.

objections: Will a creator post actually bring me customers, or just likes?
Why pay a platform fee when I can DM creators myself?
How do I know their followers are real?
I've never heard of this site, is my money safe?
$500 is a lot for one post when I don't know if it works
I don't have time to manage creators and approve drafts
habits: you check your shop's sales on your phone every evening
you post on your business Instagram yourself, a few times a week
you spend about $1,000 a month on Meta ads
you run the business with two part-time employees
you get pitched by marketing agencies by email every week
